description.value: The Crabapple Cafe is a popular all-day breakfast and brunch spot in Brackendale, a community within Squamish, well-positioned on the corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. Formerly known as the Red Bench, it draws a loyal crowd with creative West Coast dishes like a Cajun BBQ Salmon Hash made with wild barbecued salmon and house-made hollandaise. A heated patio and a warm local atmosphere make it a comfortable stop year-round.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms active operation with a feature post dated 5/30/2026, two days before today. Phone number on the website ('(604) 898-1991') matches the OSM tag. Curbside pickup and online ordering are explicitly advertised on the front page, confirming takeout. No evidence of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi was found in the available website text; the /menu, /about, /contact, and /blog subpages all returned 404. An OSM opening-hours discrepancy is worth flagging: OSM lists hours until 21:00–21:30, but an Instagram caption embedded in the website says 'Open 8am-3pm every day.'
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists service until 21:00–21:30, but an Instagram caption embedded in the website states 'Open 8am-3pm every day' — a significant discrepancy suggesting OSM hours may be outdated.
Subpages /about, /contact, /menu, and /blog all returned HTTP 404; only the front page was accessible, limiting verification of amenities and full contact details.

Reviews and website copy reference 'Brackendale' as the location, which is a distinct community within the District of Squamish — the OSM addr:city of 'Squamish' is acceptable but may cause confusion for visitors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant confirmed by a website feature dated 5/30/2026. Well-known stop on the Squamish–Whistler cycling corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The cafe was formerly known as the Red Bench, per a May 2021 guest review on the website. Email address info@crabapplecafe.ca is listed on the website front page but is not present in the OSM tags.
